This luxurious coastal home boasts a beautifully decorated interior, 6 free backpack beach chairs for use during your stay, a private fenced in backyard oasis with fire pit, and a FREE golf cart! As a guest at, "Ocean Pearl," you will enjoy having access to the many amenities found in and around this wonderfully located Inlet Beach neighborhood. You and your family are sure to love the neighborhood's large community pool, the dock for accessing Lake Powell, and all the while still being within walking distance to the many shops & restaurants of 30 Avenue! The home is just a short bike ride to reach the Rosemary Beach town center, and most importantly located only a 3-minute car ride/6 minute bike ride away from the beautiful white sandy beaches of the Emerald Coast! This large beautiful vacation home features a family-friendly open floor plan with 2 primary suites, a well-appointed gourmet kitchen, 3 living areas, 2 guest rooms, a 3rd floor loft, and a private backyard oasis with plenty of seating for the whole group. The home was set up with your family's comfort in mind providing ample seating at both the large dining table and expansive kitchen island, as well as plenty of seating in the main family room area. Your group will find even more room to spread out up on the 2nd floor in the home small 2nd living area, and the large 3rd floor loft. This home boasts a whole home air purification system, as well as whole home water purification system that uses UV light and reverse osmosis making the water you and your family will use, and drink during your stay the best there is!



During your stay at "Ocean Pearl," you will be able to enjoy all this beautiful home has to offer, as well as take advantage of accessing Lake Powell from the private community dock! Experience the fun of paddle boarding, kayaking, or fishing on one of 30A's world-famous Dune Lakes! Hot from a long day in the sun?? Enjoy swimming in the community pool, or visit one of the many wonderful restaurants or shops all within walking distance from the home. Bike the miles and miles of bike paths up and down Scenic 30A, and take advantage of all the area has to offer. Just one stay at "Ocean Pearl," and you are sure to have found your next annual family vacation destination!



Each reservation of this property includes a credit to be used towards beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita. This includes bikes, paddle boards, kayaks, tours/experiences, and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family!

Amenities:

- FREE Golf Cart (signed waiver, valid drivers license & insurance required prior to use.)

- NACS (Tesla) EV Charger (*available for use for additional cost of $10/night)

- backyard oasis with pergola, fit pit, grill & a covered seating area.

- balconies with seating

- 6 FREE backpack beach chairs

- Beach Access is only a 3-minute golf cart ride away.

- Community Pool

- Whole home air purification system

- Whole home water purification system

- Spacious open floor plan

- 3 Designated parking spaces in driveway of home

- Gourmet Kitchen

- Community Dock with access to lake Powell.



Starter Amenity Package:



All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.



SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



FAQ's

*Distance to the beach? Short golf cart ride or bike ride away (3-minute golf cart ride/6 minute bike ride)

*Distance to Community Pool? The community pool is just around the corner from the home.

*Pool heated? No

*Grill on site? Yes

*Parking spots? MAX 2 parking spots. Overflow parking is available at the community pool on a 1st come 1st serve basis.



**Please be aware that in this community and many others, there may be active construction going on. We are not held liable for this.**
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

Snorkeling, sailing, and surfing/body boarding offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.

responses.response: Thank you so much for taking the time to leave your review, Karen! We are thrilled to hear that you and your group had a great stay at Ocean Pearl. It's wonderful to know that you found the space spacious, clean, and comfortable, and that the well-stocked kitchen and common areas were ideal for relaxing. We're delighted that you enjoyed the backyard amenities, including the grill, table top fire pit, and TV. It's great to hear that the cozy bedrooms, beach chairs, extra bath towels, and basic toiletries added to your experience, and that the location was perfect for your needs. We're also pleased that the 6-person golf cart was a nice addition to your stay. Thank you for your kind words about our responsive and accommodating hosting. We truly appreciate your high recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back for another visit soon!

reviews.text:
We had an great stay at Ocean Pearl. There were 7 adults in our group, and the space was perfect — spacious, clean, and very comfortable for everyone. The kitchen was well-stocked, and the common areas were ideal for hanging out and relaxing. The backyard had plenty of seating space with a grill, a table top fire pit, and a tv. 

The bedrooms were cozy and offered plenty of privacy, and we appreciated the beach chairs, extra bath towels, basic toiletries, and instructions for check-in/out. The location was great too — close to everything we wanted to see and do, but set in a quiet neighborhood. Having a 6 person golf car was very nice to use during our stay as well.

Our host was responsive and accommodating, making the experience easy and enjoyable from start to finish. We’d definitely stay here again and recommend it for groups or families looking for a comfortable, well-equipped place to stay!

It's fantastic to hear that our customer service team was able to assist you promptly during your stay. We truly appreciate your kind words and look forward to welcoming you back for another visit soon!

reviews.text:
We stayed at Ocean Pearl for the week and it was wonderful. House was nice and clean. Plenty of space w/ 3 floors. TVs everywhere. Enjoyed the backyard patio area.

Parking says it can fit 3, but it'll be a very tight fit. Golf cart was great to use, but downside is you'll have to cross a busy intersection that doesn't have any stop lights. 

Customer service was great. I had questions during stay and they answered them quickly.

I would book with them again.
